description: Programmable temperature controller (ramps and soaks), heating and cooling: process value, set points, alarms, PID settings, control outputs, program execution and serial settings
source: Controladores Programadores para Aquecimento e Resfriamento TH 90 RP, TH 91 RP, TH 92 RP, TH 93 RP (Manual de Operação), 8ª edição 06/2025

sources.title: Controladores Programadores para Aquecimento e Resfriamento, TH 90 RP / 91 RP / 92 RP / 93 RP (Manual de Operação)
sources.note: linked in issue #121; table of register addresses, pages 39 to 42

notes: Modbus RTU on the optional RS-485 port (controllers ordered with serial communication). The manual lists registers as 40001 to 40091 (function codes 03, 06 and 16); they are numbered from 1 here, so address 40001 is register 1 and address_base is 1. The manual does not name the factory baud rate, parity or controller number: 9600, no parity and 1 are placeholders. Options are 2400, 4800 or 9600 bit/s, no, odd or even parity, 8 data bits and 1 stop bit.

Values are 16-bit integers, signed where the range includes negative numbers. The manual does not say how decimals are sent: fields with a decimal point (for example some input types) are probably sent without it, so check against the display before applying a scale.

Packed BCD registers (ALD, SETi, SETL, CFPR and AL xy) hold one digit per alarm relay (A = AL1, B = AL2, C = AL3, D unused) and are read in hexadecimal. Registers 40035, 40038, 40049, 40050, 40069 and 40070 are internal or reserved and are not listed.
The serial ID range is 1 to 63 in the register table and 1 to 31 in the parameter description. The parity code order (0 = none, 1 = even, 2 = odd) differs from the TH 9XMP manual.
Registers 40071 to 40088 apply only to programmable (ramp and soak) controllers. Registers 40083 to 40088 act on the segment chosen with PTN and SEGC.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
